monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured. The active conversion improvement is the product-neutral e-rig/e-nail comparison and return-window acceptance system. It forces an exact-model, heater, control, power, glass, cleaning, recall, service, warranty, return, first-year-cost, and end-of-life record before checkout. No brand, merchant, live price, stock, discount, rating, fabricated test, or product image was added; repair, a simpler lawful option, a non-inhaled format, or no purchase remains valid.

image_qa.note: All three pages use original text, tables, checklists, decision cards, existing interface assets, and verified source links. No patient, kidney, cannabis product, e-rig, e-nail, apartment, affiliate, stock, generated, or third-party image was added or changed, so no exact-product mismatch or new licensing ambiguity was introduced.

search_console.decision: The October 19–November 15 report is seven days old and valid: 830 impressions, three clicks, 0.361% CTR, and average position 20.688. Blue Dream (36 and 12 query impressions) and Arkansas (10 page impressions, one click, position 10.2) were already materially reinforced on November 17 and November 12. The two-impression 510-versus-disposable and trimming-scissors queries already map to exact pages; single-impression rows and administrative-page impressions are too weak or irrelevant. No page in this batch is primarily Data-led: weak or already-served signals were deliberately ignored rather than used to create cannibalizing variants. The portfolio instead expands kidney evidence and explores powered concentrate hardware and rental-housing documentation.

authority.action: Published a citation-ready kidney evidence map and clinician handoff using two current kidney-outcome cohorts, a severe-CKD pharmacokinetic study, National Kidney Foundation guidance, and FDA interaction material; added a complete heated-hardware evidence and acceptance framework; and connected a primary-source rental-housing audit to established shared-air and housing-rights paths. Reciprocal links strengthen the health-evidence, medicine-interaction, concentrate-hardware, battery-safety, shared-air, and housing clusters. No outreach opportunity was logged and no outreach was sent; strengthening these primary-source assets and crawl paths was the higher-value authority action.
